jobs:

  security-early-fail:
    name: Security (PII + Secrets)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e  # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
      - name: PII scan (INV-12, HARD)
        run: node scripts/pii-scan.mjs
      - name: Install gitleaks
        run: |
          mkdir -p \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\"
          curl -sSfL https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.27.2/gitleaks_8.27.2_linux_x64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" gitleaks
          echo \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" >> \"$GITHUB_PATH\"
      - name: Gitleaks secrets scan (INV-11)
        run: |
          gitleaks detect --source . --config .gitleaks.toml \\
            --gitleaks-ignore-path suppressions/.gitleaksignore \\
            --exit-code 1 --redact


  classify-changes:
    name: Classify Changes
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    outputs:
      docs_only: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.docs_only }}
      backend_changed: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.backend_changed }}
      frontend_changed: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.frontend_changed }}
      infra_changed: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.infra_changed }}
      high_risk: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.high_risk }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e  # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
      - id: classify
        if: hashFiles('scripts/ci-classify-changes.mjs') != ''
        run: node scripts/ci-classify-changes.mjs
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || 'origin/main' }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}




  gate:
    name: Lint (Java)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [security-early-fail, classify-changes]
    if: needs.classify-changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3
      - run: ./gradlew checkstyleMain

      - name: Dep audit OWASP DC (INV-13)
        run: ./gradlew dependencyCheckAnalyze



  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests (Java)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [gate]
    if: needs.classify-changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3
      - run: ./gradlew test

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: test-results-unit-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: build/test-results/
          retention-days: 7



  contract-tests:
    name: Contract Tests (Java)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [gate]
    if: needs.classify-changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3
      - run: ./gradlew contractTest


  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests (Java)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [unit-tests]
    if: needs.classify-changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3
      - run: ./gradlew integrationTest


  behavioral-tests:
    name: Behavioral Tests (Java)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [unit-tests]
    if: needs.classify-changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3
      - run: ./gradlew behavioralTest





  docs-check:
    name: Docs Check
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check docs updated with code changes
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # #356: rebased-aware via merge-base; bypass via [skip-docs] commit token.
          MB=$(git merge-base \"$BASE_SHA\" \"$HEAD_SHA\" || echo \"$BASE_SHA\")
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only \"$MB\" \"$HEAD_SHA\")
          LOG=$(git log --format=%B \"$MB..$HEAD_SHA\" || true)

          HAS_CODE=$(echo \"$CHANGED\" | grep -E '^(src/|__tests__/)' || true)
          HAS_DOCS=$(echo \"$CHANGED\" | grep -E '^(docs/|README\\.md)' || true)
          BYPASS=$(echo \"$LOG\" | grep -F '[skip-docs]' || true)

          if [ -n \"$HAS_CODE\" ] && [ -z \"$HAS_DOCS\" ] && [ -z \"$BYPASS\" ]; then
            echo \"::error::Code changed without documentation update\"
            echo \"\"
            echo \"Files changed in src/ or __tests__/:\"
            echo \"$HAS_CODE\"
            echo \"\"
            echo \"Please update docs/ or README.md, or add [skip-docs] to a commit message to bypass.\"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo \"Docs check passed.\"




  debt-gates:
    name: Tech Debt Gates
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [gate]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3

      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3
      - run: ./gradlew jacocoTestCoverageVerification
      - run: ./gradlew pmdMain
      - run: ./gradlew spotbugsMain
      - name: Copy JaCoCo reports to coverage/
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          cp -r build/coverage/html/. coverage/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp build/coverage/coverage.xml coverage/coverage.xml 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: coverage/
          retention-days: 30



  sonar-scan:
    name: SonarCloud Scan
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [gate]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3

      - name: SonarCloud Scan
        if: env.SONAR_TOKEN != ''
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
        run: |

          ./gradlew sonarqube -Dsonar.token=\"$SONAR_TOKEN\"




  debt-ratchet:
    name: Debt Ratchet
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    needs: [gate]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3

      - uses: actions/setup-java@c1e323688fd81a25caa38c78aa6df2d33d3e20d9  # v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@d9c87d481d55275bb5441eef3fe0e46805f9ef70  # v3

      - name: Run debt ratchet
        run: node scripts/debt-report.mjs --gate



  gate-full:
    name: Full Gate (L2, INV-59)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

    needs: [security-early-fail, classify-changes]
    if: needs.classify-changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true'

    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10  # v6.0.3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e  # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci

      - name: Install gitleaks
        run: |
          mkdir -p \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\"
          curl -sSfL https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.27.2/gitleaks_8.27.2_linux_x64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" gitleaks
          echo \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" >> \"$GITHUB_PATH\"
      - name: Install actionlint
        run: |
          mkdir -p \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\"
          curl -sSfL https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.3/actionlint_1.7.3_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" actionlint
          echo \"$RUNNER_TEMP/bin\" >> \"$GITHUB_PATH\"
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build && node scripts/build-kit.mjs
      - name: Run full L2 gate (== pre-push)
        run: node scripts/check-all.mjs --level L2 --json gate-result.json
      - name: Upload gate-result artifact (activates INV-59 runtime parity)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a  # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: gate-result
          path: gate-result.json
          retention-days: 7


  human-approval-required:
    name: Human Approval Required (INV-74)
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - name: Assert approved-by-human label (anti-bot gate)
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3  # v9.0.0
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const labels = context.payload.pull_request.labels.map(l => l.name);
            if (!labels.includes('approved-by-human')) {
              core.setFailed(
                'PR requires the \"approved-by-human\" label applied by a human reviewer. ' +
                'See 03-human-approval.yml — a bot approval does not satisfy this check.'
              );
            }

  ci-required:
    name: CI Required
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

    needs: [gate, human-approval-required, unit-tests, contract-tests, integration-tests, behavioral-tests, security-early-fail, docs-check, sonar-scan, gate-full, debt-gates, debt-ratchet, classify-changes]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - run: |
          if [[ \"${{ needs.gate.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"gate failed\"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ \"${{ needs.unit-tests.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"unit-tests failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.contract-tests.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"contract-tests failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.integration-tests.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"integration-tests failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.behavioral-tests.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"behavioral-tests failed\"
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ \"${{ needs.security-early-fail.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"security-early-fail failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.docs-check.result }}\" == \"failure\" ]]; then
            echo \"docs-check failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.sonar-scan.result }}\" == \"failure\" ]]; then
            echo \"sonar-scan failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.debt-gates.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"debt-gates failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.debt-ratchet.result }}\" != \"success\" ]]; then
            echo \"debt-ratchet failed\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.gate-full.result }}\" != \"success\" && \"${{ needs.gate-full.result }}\" != \"skipped\" ]]; then
            echo \"gate-full (L2) failed or was cancelled\"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ \"${{ needs.human-approval-required.result }}\" == \"failure\" ]]; then
            echo \"human-approval-required failed — PR needs approved-by-human label\"
            exit 1
          fi

"
